text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bringing happiness to everyone—carrying 
the 3,000-year wish of Feng Shui in her 
heart, Copano Rickey runs with all her 
might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Copano Rickey crowned as champion, 
everyone came to firmly believe that as 
long as they prepare properly and try, the 
heavens will smile upon them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Hokko Tarumae put her foot down, 
refusing to let a one-horse era begin. She 
declared she would challenge Dubai once 
more and rise above the rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The heated battles are far from over. 
Copano Rickey and her Trainer continue to 
press forward for even greater happiness.
